importContractEvidence.meaning: D26 establishes command grammar and a System Trace example; exact retained payload acceptance is this experiment's hypothesis.

limitations: Import acceptance qualifies only this unchanged input, selected reader and explicit System Trace selection; general ATRC compatibility is not established.
The observed new document is not reopened or exported here; its readability, event preservation and clock coverage are unestablished.
Output growth limits are sampled stop conditions, not a kernel-enforced aggregate storage quota; initial free space is not reserved capacity.
Read-only modes and unchanged final hashes do not prove that no write was attempted or that no caches were created elsewhere.
The pinned xctrace bytes and Xcode version do not establish equality of every framework, plugin or template byte.
Final process-group snapshots establish no live members at the snapshot, not retrospective descendant exit times.
D24's abnormal recording and D25's missing-template export refusal remain unchanged; original product acceptance remains HOLD.

nextProposedD28.doesNotPromise: Offline analysis can qualify reasoning and deterministic observer behavior; it cannot prove what the interrupted importer would have done or recover bytes absent from the artifact.
finiteWork: Reconstruct the live census, stop, signal, cleanup and retention-skip sequence from the immutable D27 receipts and source, keeping raw clocks and all reported values intact.
Address the demonstrated completed-versus-retained observation accounting defect with a focused failing-before/passing-after synthetic case; keep it separate from the unexplained scan latency.

Use deterministic synthetic filesystem/clock cases to examine the current synchronous census behavior under delayed metadata access or scheduling gaps, observed growth, link/root replacement and a live writer. Synthetic trees/timing are explicitly illustrative; exact native output filenames and the missing census history cannot be reconstructed.

State what the observer must guarantee and which observations are cooperative or sampled. Evaluate whether supervision can remain responsive while census work is bounded; do not choose a larger scan threshold from this single failure as a substitute for evidence.

End with an explicit decision and remaining evidence gap before any separately scoped native attempt. If the precise latency source cannot be recovered, say so and specify the smallest additional witness that would discriminate it.
